title: profile.json
description: What Seal Copilot knows about one site, so no later run rediscovers it. These field names are the contract: in certification 9 twelve skills wrote twelve different shapes and not one used site_name or events, which is the one thing the profile exists to prevent.

account_id.description: Not a second identifier: a record of whether the configuration tool family answered for this site.

connector.description: remote is the OAuth connector in .mcp.json (42 tools); local is npx @sealmetrics/mcp (64). Not 'remote-oauth'.

timezone.patternHint: an IANA zone such as Europe/Madrid, not an offset

currency.patternHint: the ISO 4217 code from get_site, e.g. EUR or USD

events.description: The site's REAL event names, keyed by the role they play.

discovery_cached_at.patternHint: today's date as YYYY-MM-DD; the 7-day refresh rule reads this field and a profile without it can never be judged fresh or stale

js_api.description: Cached js_api signatures from get_tracking_code, so a snippet is never written from memory.

extra.description: Anything else a skill wants to remember. Use this rather than inventing a top-level field.
